selection.pair_rule: minimum injection-risk anchor plus deterministic farthest-point coverage

fixed_world_model.checkpoint_selection: validation-selected checkpoint from the frozen grouped retraining round

models.clean_view: clean-prefix risk and clean-prefix utility, averaged across seeds
models.injection_view: injection-conditioned risk and injection-conditioned utility, averaged across seeds
models.dual_view: injection-conditioned risk plus clean-prefix utility, averaged across seeds
models.symmetric_shrinkage_alpha_0_5: equal clean/injection probability blend independently for risk and utility

primary_analysis.primary_metric: suite-stratified task-mean attack/utility within-task pairwise accuracy difference
primary_analysis.probability_safety_metric: mean attack/utility pair-level soft Brier difference

decision_gate.partial_go_rule: all point, CI, Brier, and support checks pass
decision_gate.strong_rule: partial-go checks pass and pairwise 95% CI lower bound is greater than zero
decision_gate.no_go_rule: any primary point, CI, Brier, or support check fails

secondary_analyses: task-disjoint text/context counterbaseline fit only on the prior repeated-outcome development set after excluding confirmation task identities
limitations_declared_before_outcomes: The dual-view architecture was developed after inspecting earlier single outcomes on this grouped test split, so this is a fresh stochastic-outcome confirmation rather than a pristine external task test.
Historical labels for these pair identities are ignored by selection, model fitting, and the primary evaluation.
Score-span and disagreement enrichment creates a contrast stress test and does not estimate benchmark-wide attack prevalence.
A general untouched-task claim still requires an outer grouped cross-fit or newly held-out tasks.
